annotations.exact_quote: Hyperspectral images (HSIs) are usually contaminated by various kinds of noise, such as stripes, deadlines, impulse noise, Gaussian noise, and so on
annotations.reason_zh: 论文研究对象为高光谱图像（HSIs），并处理其受多种噪声污染的去噪问题，满足高光谱图像应用对象定义。

annotations.exact_quote: propose a unified mixed Gaussian noise and sparse noise removal framework named spatial-spectral total variation regularized local low-rank matrix recovery (LLRSSTV).
annotations.reason_zh: 论文提出从受高斯与稀疏噪声污染的观测中恢复干净高光谱图像，输出为待恢复数据，符合数据补全与恢复任务。

annotations.exact_quote: rank-constrained low-rank matrix recovery is adopted to effectively separate the low-rank clean HSI patches from the sparse noise.
annotations.reason_zh: 显式采用秩约束低秩矩阵恢复，将局部干净HSI块与稀疏噪声分离，满足低秩约束/分解建模定义。
